reason: Our whole company brain lives in Notion and we talk in WhatsApp voice notes; $20 is fine money-wise but moving everything over is a week we don't have. My co-founder picks tools and he'd never sign off on rebuilding our templates.
objection: We'd lose our Notion setup and templates, and there's no mention of importing them or of voice notes, which is how half our coordination actually happens.
would_change_my_mind: A one-click Notion import that keeps our pages and templates, plus voice notes in the chat, so switching costs us an afternoon instead of a week.
